instruction: Goa Abhida Barretto commissioned Lieutenant AFMC
caption:
DEDICATION TO DUTY. Lieutenant Abhida Barretto of **Goa** recently chose the **Indian Army**. She forewent opportunities at AIIMS and JIPMER. A remarkable decision by the **NEET Topper**. 🇮🇳 Her commitment inspires future officers.
